description: Parts of the review.md §2.3 worked example that osp-survey/0.1 cannot express. They are left out of survey.json and kept here verbatim (v0 form) until the model and planning/semantics.md decide them. See fixtures/README.md.

notExpressible.why: computed variables exist (variables[].kind = computed) but the expression grammar has no if(), so the expression cannot be parsed into the AST
the model has quotas, but this one's `when` refers to the calculate above, and onFull needs an `outcome` end code that semantics has not decided (v0 has only goto)
the model has no scores and no per-item reverse scoring
the model has no allocation settings (method, strata, fallback). `between` is implied: both factors are assigned variables set by one assign node

consequences: block 'screenout' is only reached through the quota, so it is not in the flow (warning block.unused)
